scenarios.title: Workplace Feedback Situation
scenarios.description: Your manager calls you into their office and gives you critical feedback about a project you've been working on for weeks. They point out several mistakes and suggest that your approach needs 'significant improvement.' You feel your face getting warm and your heart starts racing.

adaptive_strategies.text: Think about what I can learn from this feedback
Take deep breaths to calm down
Consider my manager's perspective and intentions
Focus on how to improve and fix the issues

maladaptive_strategies.text: Argue with the feedback and defend my work
Keep thinking about how unfair this is
Try not to think about it and avoid the topic
Just push down my feelings and pretend I'm fine

scenarios.title: Social Disappointment
scenarios.description: You text a close friend asking if they want to hang out this weekend, and they respond that they're busy. Later, you see on social media that they're at a party with other people you know, and you weren't invited.

adaptive_strategies.text: Consider reasonable explanations for the situation
Remind myself that everyone faces social disappointments
Talk to my friend directly about how I feel
Do something enjoyable to take care of myself

maladaptive_strategies.text: Obsess about why I wasn't included
Isolate myself from the friend group
Tell myself I'm not likeable or worthy
Think about ways to get back at them

scenarios.title: Family Disagreement
scenarios.description: During a family dinner, a relative makes a comment about your life choices that feels judgmental and hurtful. They question your career decisions and compare you unfavorably to your siblings. Other family members are present and watching your reaction.

adaptive_strategies.text: Calmly set boundaries about acceptable topics
Acknowledge that my feelings are valid
Choose a measured response that maintains dignity
Talk to a supportive family member later

maladaptive_strategies.text: Lash out angrily at the relative
Make subtle jabs back at them
Believe their criticism and feel worthless

instructions: We'll present some scenarios. Please respond honestly about how you would feel and react.
